title: About
content:
This site is a small demonstration of a Blogger template compiled with Guchho. It uses the same template, content files and route rules that a real project would use.

What you will find here

  • Posts about templates, content and preview workflows.
  • Short guides for editing widgets and Blogger data tags.
  • Example pages that show how static routes are generated.

Why this example exists

The goal is to make the template easy to explore. Open the dashboard, change a setting, move a widget or edit a post, then rebuild to see the result in generated HTML.

Everything in this example is local content, so it is safe to experiment and replace with your own writing.
